name: Filled Amethyst Phial
summary: In Teldrassil, water from the Oracle Tree's moonwell fills an amethyst phial. Corithras Moonrage receives it for the Cenarion druids to study the World Tree's troubled growth.

sections.title: Water of the Oracle Tree
sections.body: The Oracle Glade lies in northwest Teldrassil, where the oldest and most potent moonwell rests beneath the Oracle Tree. Other moonwells across the boughs meet the night elves' daily needs, but the water here carries the raw essence of Elune's grace. Druids who watch over the World Tree's health collect it in amethyst phials, preserving it for testing and ritual cleansing.

sections.title: A Flawed Renewal
sections.body: Corithras Moonrage receives the sample as the druids watch over Teldrassil's troubled growth. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm raised the tree to replace fallen Nordrassil, but the Dragon Aspects refused to sanctify it. Without Nozdormu's blessing to restore night elven immortality or Alexstrasza's protection for its life force, Teldrassil remains stunted and afflicted by corruption. Even the sacred waters of the glade reveal the malaise taking root in the World Tree.

faq.q: Where does the water in this phial come from?
faq.answer: The water comes from the moonwell in the Oracle Glade, beneath the Oracle Tree in northwest Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why is the moonwell in Oracle Glade special?
faq.answer: The Oracle Glade moonwell is the first and most powerful moonwell created on Teldrassil. It holds the concentrated essence of Elune's power, beneath the ancient Oracle Tree.

faq.q: Who asks you to gather this water?
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage, a night elf druid stationed in Dolanaar, asks you to gather the water for the Crown of the Earth rituals.

faq.q: Why are the druids testing Teldrassil's moonwells?
faq.answer: The druids test Teldrassil's moonwells because the tree was raised without the Dragon Aspects' blessings and remains vulnerable. The samples help them watch for its troubling corruption and stunted growth.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, you fill this phial knowing the Dragon Aspects rejected your new home and your lost immortality has not returned.
As a druid, you know Cenarion druids revere moonwells as sources of nature and astral energy. They use purified vessels like this phial to study Teldrassil's blighted ecology.

attribution: Teldrassil: The Burden of the Kaldorei
